description: Data used for 'Minimum-Time MILP-based EV Charging Scheduling for Prosumers' is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Catalina Gómez-Quiles, Paula Páramo Balsa (Universidad de Sevilla). This Excel file contains a set of real and generated data, which can be useful for simulating a household power system. These data have been used for the simulations presented in the paper 'Minimum-Time MILP-based EV Charging Scheduling for Prosumers'. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
